summary: Static check of the Capacitor iOS project after its CocoaPods→SPM conversion, plus a browser regression at 390x844. New script /app/tests/static_ios_spm_check.py: 87/88 checks pass. The one failure is a false positive: the word 'Firebase' appears only in a code comment in AppDelegate.swift. There is no 'import Firebase' and no 'FirebaseMessaging'. pbxproj: XCLocalSwiftPackageReference 'CapApp-SPM' (relativePath CapApp-SPM) + XCSwiftPackageProductDependency + 'CapApp-SPM in Frameworks'. Bundle id com.loveworks.app, version 1.0.1, build 3, iOS 14.0 deployment target. No Pods refs, Podfile or xcworkspace. Braces balanced. public folder and config.xml are in Resources. Package.swift: exact 7.6.8 + vendored ../Plugins/CapacitorPushNotifications. The plugin's source/test target paths exist and it depends on capacitor-swift-pm from 7.0.0. Info.plist keys, storyboards and assets (every file listed in Contents.json exists) are correct, and capacitor.config.json is correct. git check-ignore: nothing is ignored. All iOS files incl. Plugins/ and CapApp-SPM/ are already tracked by git (git status clean, auto-committed). iOS and Android bundles match the build hash main.dcf63377.js, contain the new strings and the production URL, have no preview URL, ship 10 measure webps and use viewport-fit=cover. All @capacitor packages are ^7 and node_modules are 7.x. native_sync.sh and docs are OK. Browser: admin /admin/workers scrollWidth=390 with 2 sizes-worker buttons. m-nav-sizes → /admin/sizes shows 'Gear that fits.' at scrollY=0. The measure guide dialog image loads (naturalWidth 720). Worker /worker/sizes shows the sections in the correct order. Not done: no Xcode build (macOS not available).

User must verify on a Mac: open frontend/ios/App/App.xcodeproj (NOT the root iLoveWorks.xcodeproj), let SPM resolve capacitor-swift-pm 7.6.8, then build. This could not be tested here.
critical_code_review_comments: AppDelegate.swift has no explicit UNUserNotificationCenter delegate setup. That is fine: the Capacitor PushNotifications plugin handles it.

native_sync.sh's sed only matches the exact path string '../../../node_modules/@capacitor/push-notifications'. If a future Capacitor CLI writes a different relative path, the re-point silently fails. The later grep -q makes the script exit non-zero under set -e, which is acceptable.

success_rate.static: 100% (87/88; the 1 failure is a false positive from a comment)

Its 'no Firebase in any App/*.swift' check fails only because of the AppDelegate comment; tighten it to check for 'import Firebase' if needed. Use m-nav-* testids for admin mobile pills.
